label: Seasonal baseline
method: Synthetic actual demand: 100, 120, 80 and 100 units. Baseline forecasts of 90, 100, 100 and 110 have absolute errors totaling 60; candidate forecasts of 95, 115, 90 and 100 total 20. Dividing by four gives mean absolute errors of 15 and five units. Four days do not establish general performance.
